integrity: The proof reconstructs every resolving-neighborhood type, derives a sharp summed inequality certificate, and proves necessity and sufficiency for every optimizer. It explicitly separates prior scalar-value implications from the new all-optimizer classification. A standalone exact-arithmetic checker independently verifies the distance structure and finite stress tests.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to square-page book graphs with at least four pages.

The scalar fractional k-metric dimension follows from earlier general theory once a suitable uniform resolving function is identified; the new structural claim is the complete optimizer classification.
No claim is made for triangular books, longer-cycle books, or arbitrary generalized theta graphs.
Finite exact verification over 4 <= r <= 10 and sampled rational k values is corroborative only; the theorem for all real k in [1,4] follows from the symbolic proof.
Search coverage cannot exclude a differently named or non-indexed optimizer classification.
title: Optimal fractional \(k\)-resolving functions of square-page book graphs
